result.summary: Found 1 minor layout issue: inconsistent vertical alignment in the 'Fastest near you' carousel. The partially visible items at the right edge and bottom of the screen are expected scroll/viewport behavior and were not counted as defects.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the middle 'Smash Bros Burgers' card is shifted vertically downward compared to the adjacent cards, so its image, time badge, title, and delivery text do not share the same top/bottom baseline as the other cards in the row.
issues.suggestion: Align all carousel cards to the same top baseline with consistent image height and spacing so titles and delivery details line up horizontally.
